newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux to build Brazil factory.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux to build Brazil factory.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker Electrolux Wednesday said it would build a $150 million factory in Brazil to maker refrigerators and freezers for sale in Brazil and elsewhere in Latin America.
The factory, to be located near Curitiba, the capital of Parana, is set to come on line in 1999 or 2000 and will employ 1,200 people, Electrolux said.

The 1.5 million refrigerator and freezer units produced each year will be sold mainly in Brazil but also in Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay -- Brazil's partners in the so-called Mercosur trading bloc -- as well as other countries.
